name: 22105-visionprefill-gemma3-4b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine, served in-process through guidellm's vllm_python backend.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup 20%, no cooldown, bounded at 400 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, seed static 22105.
workload: SYNTHESISED by guidellm: each request is 20195 tokens of synthetic text plus eight images, answered in exactly 200 output tokens (min = max = 200). The images are 1280x720 gradient JPEGs at quality 85, declared as eight one-image `synthetic_image` sources with seeds 22105..22112 so that all eight land in a single turn and are byte-distinct; the processor normalises each to 896x896 and emits 256 tokens for it, so the prompt is fixed at 22275 tokens -- 20194 text, 8 x 256 image, 33 of chat template and separators. One request per row, no multi-turn.
purpose: A visual report assistant answering on eight images plus long text for eight concurrent users, short replies, one GPU.
launch:
model: unsloth/gemma-3-4b-it
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 32768
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 8, "video": 0}
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: true
